competitor_response.when_named_in_transcript: Named competitor. Address packaging and value (what is in their platform vs our add-on).
competitor_response.packaging_gaps: If they name a competitor that includes integration with CRM in-platform and we sell integration with CRM as an add-on, surface that gap and let the seller choose keep / discount / waive that fee. Waiving is 100% on that line and routes to Deal Desk.

zoominfo.rationale: Named competitor — packaging gap is integration with CRM in their core vs our add-on.

multi-year.rationale: When they are open to multi-year, offer two options: 1-year at list, or multi-year with up to this license discount. Seller chooses; do not auto-apply.

2 year.rationale: When they are open to multi-year, offer two options: 1-year at list, or multi-year with up to this license discount. Seller chooses; do not auto-apply.
